note: Literal lookups over a patient population (age, sex, attribution, conditions, latest lab thresholds, drug classes) answered by governed SQL over the semantic layer. Population clauses may come in any order; every clause must be understood.

rules.description: How many patients in a described population
rules.pattern: ^(?:how many|number of|count(?: of)?) {population}(?: (?:are there|do we have))?$

plan.purpose: Patients matching: {population.text} (latest reported age; conditions however coded; latest dated lab value; dispensed, claimed, ordered or listed drug class)

positives.question: How many patients on metformin have an eGFR below 30?
How many adults with type 2 diabetes have an A1c between 7.5% and 10.5% and an eGFR of 30 or more?
How many women 65 and older with osteoporosis are there?

negatives: How many patients on metformin have an eGFR below 30 by practice?
How many patients had an ED visit?
How many patients with diabetes are trending up on A1c?

rules.description: Which patients are in a described population
rules.pattern: ^(?:which|list(?: the| all)?|show(?: me)?(?: the| all)?|who are the) {population}$

plan.query: SELECT patient_id FROM patient WHERE {population.where} ORDER BY 1
plan.purpose: Patients matching: {population.text} (latest reported age; conditions however coded; latest dated lab value; drug class from any medication evidence)

positives.question: Which patients on metformin have an eGFR below 30?
List patients with heart failure on an SGLT2 inhibitor

negatives: Which patients on metformin should we call first?
Which patients with CKD are declining fastest?
Which practices have the most patients with diabetes?

rules.description: Share of a population with a lab or vital recorded in a period

plan.query: WITH pop AS (SELECT patient_id FROM patient WHERE {population.where}), num AS (SELECT patient_id FROM measurement WHERE concept IN {measurement.in} AND value IS NOT NULL AND {period.where:event_date} GROUP BY patient_id HAVING count(DISTINCT concept) >= {measurement.need}) SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM pop WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM num)) / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM pop), 0), 2)
plan.purpose: Percent of {population.text} with a resulted {measurement.in} record ({period.start}..{period.end}); denominator = the population

positives.question: What share of patients with diabetes or hypertension had a urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio test in the last year?
What percent of adults 65 and older with CKD had a potassium checked in 2029?

negatives: What share of patients with diabetes had an A1c above 9 in the last year?
What share of patients with diabetes had an A1c test by practice?

rules.description: Share of a population on a drug class (dispensed or claimed)

plan.query: WITH pop AS (SELECT patient_id FROM patient WHERE {population.where}), num AS (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM medication WHERE drug_class IN {drug.in} AND evidence IN ('dispensed', 'claim') AND {period.where:event_date}) SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM pop WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM num)) / nullif((SELECT count(*) FROM pop), 0), 2)
plan.purpose: Percent of {population.text} with a dispensed or claimed {drug.in} ({period.start}..{period.end})

positives.question: What share of patients with CKD are on an ACE inhibitor or ARB?
What percent of adults with heart failure are taking an SGLT2 inhibitor?

negatives: What share of patients with CKD are on an ACE inhibitor by practice?
What share of patients with CKD are on high-intensity statins?

rules.description: Patients in a population without a lab/vital recorded in a period (monitoring gaps)

which.select: SELECT patient_id FROM pop WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM num) ORDER BY 1

count.select: SELECT count(*) FROM pop WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM num)

plan.query: WITH pop AS (SELECT patient_id FROM patient WHERE {population.where}), num AS (SELECT patient_id FROM measurement WHERE concept IN {measurement.in} AND value IS NOT NULL AND {period.where:event_date} GROUP BY patient_id HAVING count(DISTINCT concept) >= {measurement.need}) {variant.select}
plan.purpose: {population.text} without every one of {measurement.in} resulted in {period.start}..{period.end}

positives.question: Which patients on levothyroxine have not had a TSH in the last year?
Which patients on ACE inhibitors, ARBs or MRAs have not had potassium and creatinine checked in 12 months?
How many patients with diabetes have not had an A1c in the last 6 months?

negatives: Which patients on levothyroxine have not had a TSH in the last year and should be called?
Which patients on warfarin have gone more than 6 weeks without an INR?

rules.description: Patients whose lab values meet a threshold on N dates (optionally a minimum gap apart) without the matching diagnosis
rules.pattern: ^how many {population} (?:have|had) (?:(?:an? )?{measurement} (?:(?:values?|results?|readings?) )?{threshold}(?: on {occasions} (?:separate )?(?:occasions|dates|days))?|{occasions} {measurement} (?:values?|results?|readings?) {threshold}(?: (?:at least )?{gap} days apart)?) (?:but |and )?(?:without|with no|no|lacking)(?: an?| any)?(?: documented)? {condition}(?: diagnosis| diagnoses| diagnosis code)?$

plan.query: SELECT count(*) FROM patient WHERE {population.where} AND patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM measurement WHERE concept = {measurement.quoted} AND {threshold.pred:value_canonical} AND event_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY patient_id HAVING count(DISTINCT event_date) >= {occasions.value} AND julianday(max(event_date)) - julianday(min(event_date)) >= {gap.value}) AND patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM concept_patient WHERE concept IN {condition.in})
plan.purpose: {population.text} with {measurement.concept} {threshold.pred:value} on at least {occasions.value} dates (first to last at least {gap.value} days apart) and no {condition.in} record (coded or labelled)

positives.question: How many patients have an A1c of 6.5% or more on two occasions without a diabetes diagnosis?
How many patients have two eGFR values below 60 at least 90 days apart but no CKD diagnosis?

negatives: How many patients have an A1c of 6.5% or more on two occasions without a diabetes diagnosis by practice?
How many adults have three or more elevated blood pressure readings without a hypertension diagnosis?

rules.description: Patients in a population with no visit of a type in a period

which.select: SELECT patient_id FROM pop WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM seen) ORDER BY 1

count.select: SELECT count(*) FROM pop WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM seen)

plan.query: WITH pop AS (SELECT patient_id FROM patient WHERE {population.where}), seen AS (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM visit WHERE type_concept = {encounter.quoted} AND {period.where:event_date}) {variant.select}
plan.purpose: {population.text} with no {encounter.value} visit (one row per encounter) in {period.start}..{period.end}

positives.question: How many attributed members have not had a PCP visit this year?
Which patients with heart failure have not had a primary care visit in the last 6 months?

negatives: How many attributed members have not had a PCP visit this year by practice?
Which members have not had a PCP visit and should be called?
